resources.string: Please tell me your symptoms. (e.g., I have a stomachache)
Please describe your symptoms in more detail.
Department:
Pain intensity: %d (0-10)
Emergency! Go to the nearest ER or call emergency services.
Field mode: Find a hospital.
Internal Medicine - Gastroenterology
Does the pain worsen after meals, or when you have an empty stomach? Did you eat spicy or greasy food?
Is it a squeezing pain, or a burning sensation (heartburn)?
Is it around the upper abdomen, lower abdomen, or all over the abdomen?
Is the pain so severe you cannot straighten your back? (NRS 0-10)
Is the pain continuous, or does it come and go intermittently?
Do you have vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, fever, or abdominal bloating?
Dermatology
Before symptoms, did you eat new food, take medication, or use new cosmetics? Were you exposed to sunlight or metal?
Is it unbearably itchy, or stinging and burning?
Is it only in specific areas (arms, legs), or spreading all over your body?
Is the itching so bad you cannot sleep? (NRS 0-10)
How long have symptoms been present? Are they worse at certain times (e.g., night)?
Do you have swelling (wheals), oozing, blisters, or warmth at the affected area?
Otolaryngology (ENT)
Does pain worsen when swallowing saliva or food? Is it worse when blowing your nose or lying down?
Is it a sharp cutting pain, or a foreign body sensation in your throat?
Is it inside your throat, around your nose, or deep in your ear?
Is the pain so severe it is difficult to eat? (NRS 0-10)
How many days ago did symptoms start? Are they worst when you wake up?
Do you have fever, cough, sputum, runny nose, or decreased hearing?
Internal Medicine - Respiratory/Cardiology
Do symptoms worsen when climbing stairs or exercising? Are you more short of breath when lying down?
Does it feel like your chest is being pressed, or like you cannot take a full breath?
Is the pain or tightness in your left chest, or does it radiate to your neck or shoulder?
Are you so short of breath you cannot speak in full sentences? (NRS 0-10)
Did symptoms start suddenly, or gradually worsen over several days?
Do you have wheezing, cold sweats, sputum (note the color), or chest pain?
Ophthalmology
Are you wearing contact lenses, or did something get into your eye?
Is your vision blurry, or does it feel gritty like sand in your eye?
Is it affecting one eye or both eyes?
Is the pain so severe you cannot open your eyes? (NRS 0-10)
Is it worse when you wake up, or does it worsen throughout the day?
Do you have decreased vision, swollen eyelids (stye), or itching?
Urology
Does pain worsen when holding urine, or during urination?
Does it feel like burning, or being stabbed with something sharp?
Does pain move from your flank down toward your groin?
Is the pain so severe you cannot stand up straight? (NRS 0-10)
Has urination frequency increased to more than eight times a day?
Do you have blood in urine, sudden high fever, or chills?
Neurology
Do symptoms worsen when turning your head or standing up?
Does it feel like electric shocks or tingling, or throbbing like being hit with a hammer?
Are symptoms limited to one side of your body (left or right)?
Is the dizziness or pain so severe you cannot carry out daily activities? (NRS 0-10)
Do symptoms appear briefly for a few seconds, or last for several hours?
Do you see double (diplopia), have slurred speech, or weakness in one arm or leg?
Obstetrics and Gynecology
Does pain worsen after sexual intercourse or vigorous movement?
Is it cramping pain, or a heavy dragging pain as if everything is falling out?
Is pain over the entire lower abdomen, or is one side (left/right) worse?
Are menstrual cramps much worse than usual and not relieved by painkillers? (NRS 0-10)
When was your last menstrual period, and for how many days have you had this pain?
Do you have abnormal bleeding, changes in discharge color/smell, or possibility of pregnancy?
Dentistry
Does pain worsen when eating/drinking something cold or hot, or when chewing?
Is it a sharp shooting pain, or a dull throbbing pain?
Can you point to the specific tooth that hurts?
Can you sleep at night without painkillers? (NRS 0-10)
Does it hurt only when eating, or does it continue even at rest?
Do you have gum bleeding, facial or jaw swelling, or loose teeth?
No pain
Mild
Moderate
Severe
Do you have squeezing or pressing chest pain that radiates to your jaw, neck, or left arm?
Are your lips or fingernails turning blue (cyanosis), or are you so short of breath you cannot speak even one sentence?
Is your stool black like tar, or have you vomited blood? Or is your abdomen rigid like a board and too painful to touch?
Along with skin symptoms, do you have voice changes or throat swelling making it hard to breathe?
Are your lips or around your eyes severely swollen, and do you feel like your blood pressure is dropping (dizziness/fainting)?
Is it difficult to swallow saliva so you keep drooling, or do you hear a metallic sound (stridor) when breathing in?
Is the area around your neck severely swollen and is it difficult even to open your mouth?
Did you suddenly lose vision in one eye completely, or is part of your vision blocked as if a curtain is drawn?
Do you have extreme eye pain as if your eye will burst, accompanied by vomiting?
Do you have severe flank pain that does not respond to painkillers, accompanied by high fever (above 38°C)?
Is no urine coming out at all, and do you feel like your bladder will burst?
Is one arm or leg so weak you cannot move it, or is one side of your face drooping and your speech severely slurred?
Did you suddenly develop the worst headache of your life, as if you were hit with a hammer?
Is bleeding so heavy that your pad soaks through in 15 minutes, and are you feeling dizzy?
With a possibility of pregnancy, do you have stabbing lower abdominal pain accompanied by cold sweats?
After an accident, have you lost bowel/bladder control, or have you lost all sensation around your anus and legs?
Is pain at the fracture site unbearably severe, and are your toes or fingers pale and numb?
Along with tooth pain, is your entire face and neck severely swollen, making it difficult to breathe or swallow?
